stem:
Farhan stirs salt and sawdust into separate glasses of water and waits. The salt disappears completely. The sawdust stays as bits you can still see.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: Salt is soluble in water. Sawdust is insoluble in water.
Salt is insoluble in water. Sawdust is soluble in water.
Salt and sawdust are neither soluble nor insoluble, because those labels apply only to liquids.
Sawdust is soluble because some bits float on the water.

teacher.key_rationale: A material that disappears completely in water is soluble; one that remains as solid bits is insoluble. The labels apply to solids here; floating bits are not dissolving.
